Introduction.SourceString: 似乎不怎么识货、整天醉醺醺的伊波恩店主。
Introduction.LocalizedString: The Boss of Eibon, who doesn't seem to be very sober.

Content.SourceString:
负责每天酩酊大醉的最不靠谱成年人（早雾语），娜娜莉崇拜的深藏不露大姐头，他人眼中神秘莫测的伊波恩店主。
此刻正捧着一只青蛙造型的美容仪细细端详。

「这位客人可真是好眼力！一眼就挑中了本人家当里最有价值的宝贝。相信您一定听说过『天使的亲吻』的传说吧？没错——能够使您的肌肤更显光泽水嫩的护肤圣品，几百年来备受精英贵族追捧的『苍白圣露』，此刻正真真切切躺在您的掌心呐。若不是……本人急需一笔资金周转，迫不得已才忍痛割爱……5万方斯！这件宝贝就属于您了！」
只见她比划了个手势，一副除此价外绝不让步的豪迈姿态。语气谄媚的商人苦起脸来，犹豫再三——
「客人可真是毫不客气啊！既然如此，5千方斯，咱们做个朋友！」

贪到什么便宜的时候，自认为淘到了什么好宝贝的时候，她总是难掩嘴角的笑意，一拍桌子喊出「成交」！
兴许不消半日就会发现被骗，进而气急败坏、借酒浇愁。
兴许等月底收到欠款账单，只得攒起眉苦下脸、懊悔莫及。

——但，至少拥有了崭新「宝物」的「当下」，无疑是值得喜悦的。
「『未来』的事呢……还是等『未来』来了再说吧~」
Content.LocalizedString:
The most unreliable adult (whose job, according to Sakiri, is to get completely wasted every day), the mysterious boss that Nanally admires, and the enigmatic boss for everyone else in Eibon.
Right now, she's examining a frog-shaped cosmetic device.

"What excellent taste you have, dear customer! You picked the most valuable treasure from my entire collection straight away! Surely you've heard the legend of the 'Angel's Kiss'? That's right! The holy grail of skincare that makes you radiant and supple, the 'Pale Sacred Dew' long-sought after by elite nobles for centuries, is now resting in your very hands! If it weren't for… my urgent need for funds, forcing me to part with this treasure… Well, 50,000 Fons! And this treasure could be yours!"
Hotori gave a dramatic gesture in a bold stance, suggesting she won't budge on the price. The merchant, who was speaking in flattering tones, made a pained expression and hesitated.
"Customer, you really don't hold back! In that case, 5,000 Fons. Let's be friends!"

Whenever she thinks she's getting a bargain, or whenever she believes she's found some treasure, she can never hide the smile appearing on her face as she slams the table and shouts "Deal!"
Perhaps within half a day she'll discover she's been scammed, then become furious and drown her sorrows in alcohol.
Or perhaps when she receives the bill at the end of the month, she'll furrow her brow with bitter regret.

But at least the moment of owning a brand new "treasure" is undoubtedly worth celebrating.
"As for the future… well, we'll deal with that when the future comes!"

Content.SourceString:
「『畅饮』的意思是，按人数支付固定的价格，直到退桌结账的时候，可以无限地从饮品区拿取饮品饮用的商业形式……菜单上是如此说明的。」
「酒也可以不限量拿吗？还挺大方~那大家今天就趁机好好享受享受，小鬼们也给我死命去拿最贵的那种果汁！」
「……碰到像浔这样脸皮厚又特别能喝的客人，铁定会亏钱的吧？」
这种模式为应付无节制的客人，当然也有对策，除了各品类饮料的库存之外，就是时间限制了……只是呢，放在浔身上，刚巧不成问题。
——但，就后来的实际情况而言，浔为了让「畅饮」发挥最大的性价比而顺便追加了一桌又一桌的下酒菜……这趟难得的下馆子，结果还是以花销大幅超出预算告终。
Content.LocalizedString:
"'All-you-can-drink' means you pay a fixed price based on the number of people in your group, and until you leave and settle the bill, you can take unlimited beverages from the drink area… that's what their menu says."
"Including alcohol? That's pretty generous! Everyone should really enjoy themselves today, and you kids better go grab the most expensive juice they have!"
"…Restaurants definitely lose money when they run into shameless customers like Hotori who can really hold their liquor, right?"
Of course, this business model has countermeasures for dealing with customers who go overboard: besides the inventory limits for each type of beverage, there's also the time restriction… but when it comes to Hotori, that just happens to not be a problem.
However, based on what happened later, when Hotori kept ordering table after table of appetizers to maximize the value of the all-you-can-drink deal… This rare dining-out experience still ended up with expenses far exceeding the budget.

Content.SourceString:
伊波恩古董店内暂不存在古董品之间深夜开畅谈会的情况，或许吧……毕竟也没几个会说话的。这并不妨碍「日月瞳方仪」在无聊时骨碌碌转一圈环视店里其它的家伙们，展开想象。
（喂喂，新来的，你从哪来的？）
（我之前睡在一个脏兮兮的地摊，被眼缘看中买下了。赎身费998方斯，在这家店地位算底层吗？）
（还有好多根本不知道自己身价的呢。比如我，在一个又黑又窄的地方呆了好久好久……久到我以前被磕出来的那条小裂痕都长了个子，顺利和原本雕刻上的花纹会师了……直到……有光照进来，那女人出现了，把我轻轻地取了出来，笑了。）
（是那种得逞的贼笑吗？）
（不。是似乎很笃定我就在那里的、确信如此的笑。但不知为何，她反而因为那个笑容而显得有些……遗憾的样子？）
（哈哈，怕不是把灰拍干净才发现你没有想象中品相好导致的吧？）
未曾发生也不会发生的讨论在「日月瞳方仪」吧嗒吧嗒的眨眼声配音中愈发热火朝天起来。「哀南姆镜」则仅仅是平和地映照着，映照着镜面前方所有的寂然不动与时过境迁。
Content.LocalizedString:
There are currently no late-night chat sessions happening between antiques in Eibon… probably. After all, not many of them can talk. This doesn't stop the Temporal Globe from rolling around when bored, surveying the other items in the shop and letting its imagination run wild.
(Hey, newcomer, where are you from?)
(I used to sleep in a dirty street until someone took a liking to me and bought me. The cost of my freedom was 998 Fons. Does that put me at the bottom of the hierarchy in this shop?)
(There are plenty who don't even know their own worth. Like me, I stayed in a dark, cramped place for ages and ages… so long that the little crack I had grew bigger and successfully merged with the original carved patterns… until… light came in. That woman appeared, gently lifted me out, and smiled.)
(Was it one of those scheming, triumphant smirks?)
(No. It was a completely confident smile, like she was certain I'd be there. But for some reason, that smile made her seem somewhat… regretful?)
(Haha, I bet she dusted off the dirt only to discover you weren't in as good condition as she imagined!)
The discussion that never happened and never will happen grows more animated, accompanied by the blinking sounds of the Temporal Globe. The Mirror of Anam simply reflects peacefully, capturing all the stillness and the passage of time across its surface.

Content.SourceString:
采用了掐丝珐琅工艺的精致怀表。
鬼兰花纹的正上方镶嵌着一枚橙红色的玉石，像是褪色于悠长岁月而温润起来的眼眸般……表盘却依然色彩明亮细腻，丝毫不显陈旧。
既不是异象，也不是异能制品。虽然打造得足够精美，但确实只是一块没有任何特殊能力的、普通的怀表而已。
浔从不谈它的具体价值，兴许是什么压箱底的好宝贝？不到伊波恩濒临破产之际都不会拿出来换钱的……最终保险也说不定呢？
Content.LocalizedString:
An exquisite pocket watch crafted with cloisonné enamel technique.
Above the ghost orchid pattern, an orange-red gemstone is set, like eyes that have grown gentle after fading through long years… Yet the watch face still retains bright and delicate colors, showing no signs of age.
It's neither an Anomaly nor an Esper creation. Though beautifully crafted, it's truly just an ordinary pocket watch without any special powers.
Hotori never discusses its actual value. Perhaps it's some precious treasure she keeps hidden away? Something she wouldn't sell for money unless Eibon was on the verge of bankruptcy… her ultimate backup insurance, maybe?

Content.SourceString:
月退家的院子很配积雪，令人感觉多了层历史悠久的风韵感，好比给陈列的古董品盖上尘埃的毛毯——只不过，是素白的、洁净的尘埃。
可惜每年每年，这样的风景也都在转瞬间过去了。浔总这么觉得。
小小年纪就已经对四季流转岁月变迁颇具伤感，那是因为，她惧怕瞬息万变的外界为这个避世的家族带来她所不愿见到的变化。要能一切就此在最为完整的时刻凝固为静物，多是一桩美事呢。
「最佳的赏雪期，是它正在融化的时候。为此……要处于动态中，才行吧。」
在她真的能够使雪景停驻的许多年后，某一个初春，她并非偶然地遇见一位曾在自家宅邸小住过一段时间的门客。如今已是耄耋之年的老者，闲谈起来每讲一句，便要抿一口酒碟。
浔想起来，这就是最后一会了，她斟上酒，罕见郑重地等待着倾听下一句有感而发。
「最珍贵的，并非不变和永恒。是会破碎的……正在破碎的那些事物啊。」
Content.LocalizedString:
The Tsukinoki family's courtyard pairs perfectly with fallen snow. The snow gives it an added sense of historical elegance, like covering displayed antiques with a blanket of dust—except this dust is pure white and pristine.
Unfortunately, year after year, such scenery passes by in the blink of an eye. Hotori has always felt this way.
Even at a young age, she was already deeply melancholic about the changing seasons and passing years. This was because she feared that the ever-changing outside world would bring unwanted changes to this reclusive family. How wonderful it would be if everything could freeze like a still life at its most perfect moment.
"The best time to appreciate snow is when it's melting. For that… you need to be in motion, don't you?"
Many years later, when she truly could make snowy scenes stand still, one early spring she encountered—not by chance—an old guest who had once stayed at their family estate for a time. Now an elderly man in his twilight years, he took a sip from his wine cup after every sentence during their casual conversation.
Hotori realized this would be their final meeting. She poured the wine and waited with rare solemnity to hear his next heartfelt words.
"What's most precious isn't what remains unchanged and eternal. It's the things that break… the things that are breaking right now."

Content.SourceString: 生面孔呀……是客人……？……呃……仔细一看，这……不是我家招财宝么？嘶……竟然头晕到看错了……解酒药解酒药……
Content.LocalizedString: A new face… A guest…? …Wait… isn't that my Precious?! Ugh… I'm so dizzy I can't even tell… I need a hangover cure…

Content.SourceString: 你们在外处理委托的时候，一定要注意维护本店的口碑。咳咳……先说好，我可是一点都不在意「猎人帮」上对伊波恩的低评分，那东西……说到底只是个数字！哪有我们客人真心实意的感谢来得重要呢？
Content.LocalizedString: When you're out on a job, make sure to protect our shop's rep. Cough… And for the record, I couldn't care less about the low ratings for Eibon on Hyelp. Numbers on a screen, nothing more! Real gratitude from real customers is what matters!

Content.SourceString: 方斯……方斯……「方斯」这个名字是谁起的？我怎么越念越觉得顺口，越听越觉得悦耳了？「方斯」……真不错，我可太喜欢这个词了。
Content.LocalizedString: Fons, Fons, Fons… Who came up with that name? The more I say it, the better it sounds… "Fons"… what a lovely word.

Content.SourceString: 我一会去趟桥间地的跳蚤市场，帮我把店看好，别给拆了……去干什么？呵呵，当然是~去淘点好东西回来。
Content.LocalizedString: Look after the shop for me, I'm heading to the flea market at Bridge Crossings… What for? Heh, treasure hunting, of course.

Content.SourceString: 我可不像小鬼们天天有使不完的劲到处瞎溜达，等个不怎么晒的日子再出门好咯。
Content.LocalizedString: I'm not like those kids with endless energy to burn, running around every day. I'll wait for a nice, shady day before I go out again.

Content.SourceString: 听窗外这雨淅淅沥沥地落……我有了个好点子……家里院子我瞅着一直感觉挺空的，挖个锦鲤池怎么样！
Content.LocalizedString: Listening to this rain outside… I just had a great idea… Our yard feels a bit empty, doesn't it? What about a koi pond?

Content.SourceString: 在这个城市，即使是最冷的时节也还算过得去吧，下雪也不多见，偶尔我都有点怀念老家了。
Content.LocalizedString: In this city, even the coldest season doesn't feel too bad… and snow's rare. Honestly, I kinda miss home sometimes.

Content.SourceString: 唉，这天跟蒸笼似的……在把冰好的酒拿出来之前，先知会我一声吧，不然没消一会儿都变成一壶温酒了。
Content.LocalizedString: Ugh, it's boiling out here… Let me know before you grab the chilled sake, okay? Otherwise it'll warm up in no time.

Content.SourceString: 到底是谁啊？臭小鬼还是塔吉多？天还没亮就在楼下不停地捣鼓捣鼓捣鼓……今天我非得揪出来教训一顿不可。
Content.LocalizedString: Who is it?! That brat or Taygedo?! Clattering around downstairs at night… They're in for a lesson today.

Content.SourceString: 呼，这可是最容易觉得乏的时候了，我去阴凉处歇会儿。
Content.LocalizedString: Ugh… this is the drowsiest time of day. I'm gonna rest somewhere cool.

Content.SourceString: 今天的营业额是……怎么又是赤字？
Content.LocalizedString: Today's revenue is… how is it in the red again?

Content.SourceString: 好酒，好酒……哼哼，「明明酒杯已经空了」？这种事我当然知道，可你看这月色——免费，况且，还是「无限续杯制」呢？嗯~再给我满满地斟上吧。
Content.LocalizedString: Great drink… Hmph, "The glass is already empty"? Yeah, I noticed. Just look at this moonlight. It's free. And hey, it offers unlimited refill, right? Fill it up again, to the brim.

Content.SourceString: 这世道，外头什么兴趣爱好不费钱哪？要说还不如和我的小水仙聊天比较好玩，抿两口美酒，逗她两句，再欣赏欣赏反应……可是一大趣事呢~
Content.LocalizedString: These days, what hobby doesn't cost money? Honestly, chatting with Daff is more fun. Sip a little, tease her a bit, enjoy the reaction… now that's good entertainment.

Content.SourceString: 区区水电费，凭什么要这么多……埃德嘉快用你聪明的小脑瓜帮我算算，这个数，能对吗？……什么！？商用水电……啧……经营这些年，我还头一回知道有这种事……
Content.LocalizedString: Why's the utility bill this high… Edgar, use that clever little brain of yours and double-check this number… What!? Commercial rates?! Tch… all these years and I'm only finding this out now…

Title.SourceString: 话题·异象·《忧郁的美男子》

Content.SourceString: 要是闲着没事，你们就多找那幅画聊聊吧。尽量自然点，想法子安慰他几句。省得天天唉声叹气自己脸上又怎么怎么干裂的，听着头疼。上次路过走廊，竟然还问我讨护肤品，说要我帮忙抹在颜料的缝隙中间，真是个够异想天开的家伙！
Content.LocalizedString: If you're bored, go chat with that painting. Try to be natural and say something nice. I'm tired of hearing it moan about how its face is cracking. Last time I passed by, it even asked for skincare cream to dab between the brushstrokes! Absurd!

Content.SourceString: 伊波恩的交易须知上有几句不太方便给客人看到的话……这件事我知道了。刚定下来的时候没怎么细想就写了点心里话嘛……再说，交易这件事，不是最该看双方的坦诚？你们要是觉得上头有什么语气不妥的，递给客人看之前帮我涂涂掉就是。至于重新拿去打印就不必了，现在的文印店也是黑得很……印完才说价钱，凭几张纸也敢狮子大开口……像伊波恩这样打开天窗说亮话的良心商家，可是难找咯。
Content.LocalizedString: There are a few lines in Eibon's terms of trading service that aren't exactly the best things to let customers know… Yeah, I know. When I first wrote them, I just jotted down what I felt… Still, trade's all about honesty, right? If anything sounds off, just cross it out before showing the client. No need to reprint. Printing shops these days are daylight robbery… Shops honest as Eibon aren't very likely to survive in this evil world…

Content.SourceString: 招财宝，过来给我参谋参谋。我在琢磨怎么给咱们店的委托协议添上一条……呃，「有需求约请本店鉴定师进行异象鉴定服务的，在总价基础上加收50%服务费」，如何？……瞧你头摇得跟拨浪鼓似的，这么不满意的话……加收80%！就这么定了！
Content.LocalizedString: Hey, Precious, come help me out. I'm thinking of adding a line to our commission form… something like, "A 50% service fee applies if you request anomaly appraisal by our in-house Appraiser." What do you think?… What's with that head shake? Fine—80%! Deal!

Content.SourceString: 「时间」并不只是路径，也可以是……视角。
Content.LocalizedString: "Time" isn't just a path. It's also… a point of view.

Content.SourceString: 我呢，透过「岁月」所提供的衡量尺度，鉴赏过了数之不尽的奇珍异宝。要开一家古董店，这点阅历还是得有吧……你说最近经常看走眼？唔，大概是因为家里新进的招财宝太叫人省心了，这才有所懈怠了吧。
Content.LocalizedString: Through the lens of "Time," I've appraised countless rare artifacts. You gotta have that kind of eye to run an antique shop… What? My judgments have been off lately? Hmm… Maybe it's 'cause Precious here is just too dependable and I've been letting my guard down too much…

Content.SourceString: 什么叫甩手掌柜？又是听哪个没当过家的臭小鬼讲的？伊波恩的进货大业可一直是我在操持……再说，经营方面都有阿德勒把关，我作为一店之主应该要负责的部分，理应是决策啊决策。
Content.LocalizedString: What do you mean I'm a hands-off boss? Which brat told you that? I've always handled Eibon's inventory. And besides, Adler's managing the operations. My job is to make decisions for the business! That's where leadership is.

Content.SourceString: 瞧瞧瞧瞧，开店这几年来，阿德勒眉眼周围这一大堆细细小小的皱纹，冒得跟雨后春笋一样。闯祸精们又哪里懂得，大人们跟在屁股后头操了多少心？
Content.LocalizedString: Look, look, look—see those fine lines around Adler's eyes? Popped up like mushrooms after rain since we opened. The little troublemakers have no idea how much we adults stress over them.

Content.SourceString: 小水仙不怎么会主动喝酒，不过只要你说「干杯」，她就会一杯一杯地陪你喝下去——毕竟我同她说过，干杯之后必须得喝上至少半杯，这是喝酒的基本礼仪。哼哼，然后……说不定你就能看到一些有意思的事情了？她酒量可没有自己想象得那么好。
Content.LocalizedString: Daff doesn't drink much on her own, but if you say cheers and invite her to a toast, she'll down one after another. I told her, after toasting, you'll have to drink at least half a glass—it's basic etiquette. Heh heh… and then… who knows what fun you'll see? Her tolerance isn't what she thinks it is.

Content.SourceString: 早雾呢，是个挺机灵的孩子，可以想见，以后能栽培成一个相当能干的小店员。只不过这个喜欢拆我台的毛病呐，我可得找机会好好给她矫正矫正……
Content.LocalizedString: Sakiri's a clever one. She's got potential to be a great little shopkeeper. But this habit of undercutting me? I'll need to straighten that out properly someday…

Content.SourceString: 想来最早发现塔吉多的时候，我还高高兴兴想着能省下一笔买电视的钱，后来店里小鬼头多了，天天聚在一起占着塔吉多看什么动画片啊特摄剧的……唉，等哪天发财了，我要再买个有一面墙那么大的超大屏液晶电视……
Content.LocalizedString: When I first found Taygedo, I was thrilled. Thought I could save on buying a TV. But now the kids hog it every day, watching anime and what not… Sigh. One day, when I strike it rich, I'm getting a screen as big as a wall…

Content.SourceString: 娜娜莉！又在外头砸坏了人家什么东西，这赔款单子怎么一声不响地就寄到家里了？……小崽子跑哪去了……啧，阿德勒，听着，一个月……算了，一个礼拜吧！你早饭不准给她做她最喜欢的那个蛋卷，这次一定要让她长长记性……记得别又偷偷摸摸给她做了！
Content.LocalizedString: Nanally! What did you break this time?! Why'd the compensation notice show up at our door without warning?! …Where'd that little rascal go… Tch, Adler! Listen, one month—argh, maybe one week! No eggrolls for her. Make her remember this time… and don't sneak her any!

Content.SourceString: 像埃德嘉这样，安静乖巧、听话懂事，最大的兴趣也不过就是看看书，既不用费钱又不用费心的好孩子，究竟是怎么教育出来的？真想向他父母取取经……
Content.LocalizedString: Edgar's such a quiet, well-behaved kid. Loves books, doesn't ask for much. How did his parents raise him so well? I need to take notes…

Content.SourceString: 对于我们亲爱的局长大人，你可得多留个心眼，别被她逮着什么把柄。我可不想再被叫去开什么「家长会」了……每次那副冷脸一拉，会客室的高档沙发都要变得不舒服起来……唉，指不定还没家里这破沙发好坐……
Content.LocalizedString: Keep an eye on our dear Director. Don't let her catch you slipping. I don't want to get dragged into another "parent-teacher meeting." Every time she pulls that cold face, even the premium guest couch starts feeling stiff… Honestly, it's probably less comfy than the ratty old one at home.

Content.SourceString: 早知道这地方不灵光，图个性价比图进了死胡同里，生意是根本做不起来~至于为什么还是选了将伊波恩开在这儿……呵，因为，没有什么「早知道」，缘分使然。
Content.LocalizedString: I should've knew this location was no good. Cheap rent led me into a dead end—business is a bust! So why still choose to open Eibon here? Heh, because there's no such thing as "should've known." It's fate.

Content.SourceString: 这风水，我估摸着要好起来了。
Content.LocalizedString: I'd say… the universe might just start working in this place's favor.

Content.SourceString: 该挥霍就要挥霍。阿德勒，把我一直没舍得开的那瓶拿来！
Content.LocalizedString: Gotta spend when it counts. Adler, bring me that bottle I've been saving!

Content.SourceString: 「现在」，兴许是最值得纪念的时候……也说不定呢？
Content.LocalizedString: "Now" might just be the most memorable moment of all… who knows?

Content.SourceString: 嚯，这好东西是上哪淘来的！眼光真不错啊！我很中意！
Content.LocalizedString: Ooh! Where did you get this? You have great taste! I like it!

Content.SourceString: 称得上是宝贝了！咱们家的家宝，又多了一件哪~
Content.LocalizedString: This is the real deal! We got another precious one now!

Content.SourceString: 招财宝今天怪殷勤的嘛……谢谢了~
Content.LocalizedString: Precious, you're trying really hard… Appreciate it!

Content.SourceString: 哎呀~都是一家人，跟我客气什么？
Content.LocalizedString: Well, we're family, right? Don't be a stranger!
A little show-off.
Let me take a closer look.
Haven't gone rusty, have I?
It'll only be a moment.
The tides of the world, drawn to this place.
And thus, time flows on.
Arriving at this very moment.
The moon has set.
Heh…
Let's see… what's it worth?
Hmm… decent condition.

Content.SourceString: 这下，该消停上一会了吧。
Content.LocalizedString: That should be good for a while.
Another complete mission.
Here comes the money!
If you ask me, that one's the real deal…

Content.SourceString: 有便宜可捡却要装没看到，岂不是显得不够尊重？
Content.LocalizedString: Ignoring a good deal? That's just rude.

Content.SourceString: 真有天上掉馅饼的好事？
Content.LocalizedString: Something that good just fell into your lap?

Content.SourceString: 管他值不值钱的，先拿上再说！
Content.LocalizedString: Who cares if it's worth anything. Finders keepers!
Pretty good luck today!
Everything has its time and place…

Content.SourceString: 麻烦。这次的开价还是低咯。
Content.LocalizedString: Annoying. Price is still too low.
Drink something to warm yourself up a bit…
Like fine wine.
Mmm… that's the spot.
Shame… timing was off…
Here's… my moment…
Heh… I can see the old days…
Behaving now?
See you around.
Tsk.
Tch.
Not bad at all.
What a drag.

Content.SourceString: 为了赚回点口碑……嗯……顺带，也该活动下了。
Content.LocalizedString: Time to win back some reputation… and stretch a bit too.

Content.SourceString: 可不能叫咱们伊波恩的人，在外头吃亏呢。
Content.LocalizedString: Can't let our folks at Eibon get pushed around out there.
How rude.
How rude!
Show them out.
Alright, let's go!
Whew!
Here I am!
Did you need something?
Don't worry, we have plenty of time.
You worked hard.
Help me keep an eye on the little ones.
Make sure to keep an eye on Kiroumaru!
So noisy, you troublemaker.
What a handful!
Another mess to clean up?
Just stay behind.
Let me give you a hand.
Let's wrap this up soon.
Don't push yourself too hard.
Don't hurt my precious!
Perfect timing.
Nothing stays the same forever…
See what happens when you try to act tough?

Content.SourceString: 你还有很长的路要走呢。
Content.LocalizedString: You still have a long way to go.
Sleep now, my little Daff…
Good kid, you did your best.

Content.SourceString: 招财宝……这仇非得替你报了！
Content.LocalizedString: Precious… I will avenge you!
Still not quite enough power there!
The supple touch prevails over force.

Content.SourceString: 那点小伎俩，我早就看穿了~
Content.LocalizedString: I saw through those little tricks ages ago!

Content.SourceString: 唉，打不准就再回去练练。
Content.LocalizedString: You honestly need more practice.
